items.name: Open HidUSBF Setup (required)
items.description: Opens the HidUSBF Setup tool (run as admin). Use it to Install Service, enable Filter on Device, and set polling rate.

items.name: Apply: Controller Overclock (Guided)
items.description: Opens HidUSBF Setup (included). In HidUSBF: select your controller, enable Filter On Device, pick polling rate (250/500/1000 Hz), click Restart. Toggle ON after you apply in HidUSBF; toggle OFF after you disable Filter On Device in HidUSBF.

items.name: USB Power Management Checklist
items.description: Opens Device Manager. For each USB Root Hub / controller: Properties → Power Management → uncheck 'Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power'.

items.name: Apply: Disable GameInput Service (optional)
